reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Charizard Y with Hisuian Goodra provided the necessary Sun-boosted offense and Sap Sipper / Dragon coverage to break through opponent's Scarf Garchomp and Rotom-Mow under Tailwind.
reflections.adjustment: Preserve Charizard-Y's HP better in the mid-game by utilizing Wide Guard Garganacl or safer pivots into Goodra when double Rock Slide threats like Garchomp and Dragonite are on the field.

reflections.summary: Lost because preview of Sneasler/Garchomp/Dragonite/Rotom is hard-countered by Goodra-Hisui + ZardY. Scarf Rock Slide Garchomp + Rock Slide Dragonite are both resisted by Goodra and blocked by Zard Protect stall, while both Dragons are OHKOed by Modest Dragon Pulse. After killing Venusaur T6, we had no answer to Goodra bulk + SapSipper (blocks Rotom Grass) and ZardY sun, Sneasler was already gone so no Fake Out to punish Protects.
reflections.adjustment: Don't bring double Dragon + Scarf spread Rock Slide into Wide Guard/Goodra. Next game bring only one Dragon, keep Tailwind but rely on single-target Thunderbolt/Ice/Fighting to bypass Wide Guard: Rotom Thunderbolt for ZardY, Sneasler Close Combat/Ice for Goodra-H (Steel/Dragon weak to Fighting), preserve Multiscale and Fake Out to secure ZardY when it Protects instead of double Rock Slide.
